alerts.title: West Suburban Medical Center — Permanently Closed
alerts.description: West Suburban Medical Center has permanently closed all services including its emergency department. 23,000+ patients displaced. No transition plan was provided to patients.

alerts.title: Loretto Hospital ER — Over Capacity
alerts.description: Loretto Hospital ER operating at 97% capacity after absorbing West Suburban overflow. Average wait times now 78 minutes, up from 42 minutes pre-closure.

alerts.title: Stroger Hospital ER — Near Capacity
alerts.description: Cook County Stroger ER at 97% capacity. Wait times averaging 94 minutes. West Side overflow contributing to system strain.
